done_when: When a cold read or review loop stops, forge read, forge close, forge land and forge next print a ready-to-ask question that names the item in plain words and what it delivers, lists each open blocking note or finding as one plain sentence saying what goes wrong for whom, and says what accept, narrow and split would each concretely do for this item, and the guide tells the coordinator to ask exactly that

dismissals.because: Human accepted the remaining finding: Coordinator decision under the owner's bar (Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 1): forge next shows only the document error while a stopped story's draft is malformed; fixing the draft brings the question back. Recorded as lived-with.

findings.body: Raise: Not done. If a story draft is edited after its third blocked cold read and the edit makes it temporarily malformed, `forge next` reports only the document error. The existing parse check at `src/forge/nextstep.py:421-425` returns before the new stopped-read question path runs, even though `forge read` still requires the owner’s accept, narrow or split choice. The named test edits the stopped draft but keeps it valid, so it does not catch this gap.
findings.title: Not done: forge next loses a stopped story’s question when its draft is malformed
